question: Carbon compounds that are linked by only a single bond are known as _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**saturated compounds**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Carbon compounds **linked by only a single bond are known as saturated compounds.**
 
• The **general formula for saturated compounds is CnH2n+**1, where n represents the number of carbon atoms in the compound. 
 
• **Hexane, decane, and octadecane **are examples of saturated compounds. 
 
• Saturated also implies that the compound shall have no multiple carbon-carbon bonds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Carbon compounds **that have double or triple bonds between their carbon atoms are called unsaturated compounds.**
 
• Unsaturated compounds** produce a yellow flame with lots of black smoke due to incomplete combustion in the air**
 
• Unsaturated compounds **are made up of carbon and hydrogen atoms, and contain at least one double or triple bond.**
 
• **Examples of unsaturated compounds include ethene (C2H4), benzene (C6H6), propene (C3H6), and butadiene (C4H6). **
 
• The main types of unsaturated compounds are alkenes, alkynes, and aromatic hydrocarbons: 
 
• **Alkenes: **Contain one or more carbon-carbon double bonds 
 
• **Alkynes:** Contain one or more carbon-carbon triple bonds 
 
• **Aromatic hydrocarbons: **Contain a benzene or aromatic ring in their structure ​
